records.context: Every metric here is cheap to compute, by design. A sweep runs hundreds of trials, so a per-trial diagnostic that costs seconds costs hours across the run. The full 23-panel suite in :mod:`spacr.regression_qc` was measured at ~5.8 s per fit -- ten minutes per hundred trials. These scalars were measured at 73-230 ms on application view-shaped fits (606-2400 rows, 200-400 parameters), which is under half a percent of the ~60 s a real trial takes.
